title: editor tutorial / Preview the app in the integrated browser
content: ## Preview the app in the integrated browser The built-in [integrated browser](/docs/debugtest/integrated-browser.md) opens local HTML files directly in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. You don't need an extension, development server, or external browser to preview this app. 1. In the Explorer view, right-click `index.html`, and then select **Open in Integrated Browser**. The app opens in an integrated browser tab. ![Screenshot of the completed recipe app in the integrated browser](../images/getting-started/recipe-app-screenshot.png) 1. Check the app manually: * Add a recipe with a name and description, and confirm that it appears in the list. * Select **Delete**, and confirm that the recipe disappears. * Try to submit an empty field, and confirm that the browser asks you to complete it. * Enter only spaces in a field, and confirm that the browser asks for a non-space character. * Enter `Soup` as a recipe name, and confirm that the app displays the characters as text rather than formatting them as HTML. 1. In `index.html`, change `My recipes` to `Favorite recipes`, and then save the file. Check that the browser shows the new heading. If it hasn't reloaded automatically, select **Reload** in the browser toolbar. This small edit demonstrates the edit, save, and review cycle you use throughout {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}.
